Dialogs.Dialog: Kobayakawa
Coming to places like this in spring, I start to think they might be nice.
'Places like this' meaning the cherry tree path？
Yeah. It's like walking through a pink tunnel. It makes me feel strange.
Yeah, it really is. Magical, I guess you'd call it.
With it this pretty, I kind of get why people want to do flower viewing.
Oh yeah？ But you don't like noisy stuff, right？
Well, loud drunks are the worst.
True. But being rowdy is kind of the point of Japanese flower viewing.
Barbaric. They should enjoy it quietly, like cultured people...
Did you think that sounded like an old lady？ You're the old man here.
Kobayakawa
Phew... So hot... Rinko really can't stand summer...
At least get in the shade. It helps a little.
...Yeah. I will.
I used to be fine with summer, back then...
Back then...
Somewhere along the way, I started hating summer...
Sorry for dragging you out here when you hate the heat...
The heat's not your fault, is it？
But if you bought me a juice, I might be happy. In one minute.
Five. I'll go get it...
Feels like fall...
Kobayakawa
If you're not careful, a whole year'll just fly by.
Someday, walking side by side like this will be a memory too, huh.
...That makes me lonely. Can I get closer？
I wonder if I feel like that because it's fall.
Maybe. It's kind of a lonely season.
But becoming a memory isn't a bad thing, right？
Of course.
Then okay. Let's make today a memory too...
It's really winter now.
Kobayakawa
I like winter, but seeing the trees without leaves is kind of sad.
They're just taking it easy, waiting for spring.
Spring... I hate when the bugs come out, but I want to see the cherry blossoms soon.
But Rinko really does like winter.
Why？ Isn't it cold？ Or is it the winter sports season？
No. Well, that too, but not just that...
It's because we can stick close together just because it's cold.
Kobayakawa
Oh, that takes me back.
Nostalgic？
Yeah. That tree. It used to be Rinko's very own bug tree.
Did you climb it？
No climbing. I told you before, I just picked up the ones that fell.
Huh. Want to go take a closer look？
Hey. We don't need to.
But it's ▲小早川＊▲'s tree, right？ I want a closer look.
It's just like the trees around it. No point looking.
Come on, come on. Let's go.
Geez... What's so fun about this...
Kobayakawa
I never noticed back then, but these stairs are pretty long, huh？
From far away, they don't look that long, though.
Maybe they grew while no one was looking.
You never noticed back then, right？ Then it's simply that your stamina's dropped or...
No way. If you're gonna say that, want to race？
A race？
Hey, wait！ Don't just take off running！
How's that？ I win.
I'm tired. Race over.
Wha...
Fine, fine. Let's just say Rinko's not as young as she used to be.
(Good grief...)
Since we're here, want to draw a fortune？
Kobayakawa
Nah, I'm good.
My luck's pretty good, so it'll be fine.
Says who？
I've got a cute girlfriend, so...
...Yeah, yeah. Do whatever you want.
'Misfortune'...
Hmm...
But the love section's good. 'Don't let the one you have get away.' See？
...Obviously. Total waste of time after all.
Kobayakawa
That was a good movie. Still, I didn't expect ▲小早川＊▲ to cry at a movie.
Huh？ I didn't cry？
I mean, all that bad luck hitting those two over and over？ Is that even realistic？
It wouldn't be a movie otherwise.
And the breakup scene. How could they just accept it？ If they really loved each other, they'd fight it.
True, but... you really were paying attention.
How can anyone call a movie this unrealistic a 'tearjerker'？
(She was crying, though...)
That was fun. Movies like that make you feel like you've gotten stronger.
Kobayakawa
What？ The action was cookie-cutter. Explosions, kung fu, car stunts... They just threw everything in.
I didn't think it was that bad... You watched it pretty critically, huh.
Of course... I did！
Whoa, that was close！
Huh... You dodged it？ Just so you know, you won't dodge Rinko's low kick that many times.
(The movie got to her!?)
How was it, ▲小早川＊▲？
Kobayakawa
...Hah.
What's wrong？
I laughed so hard I thought I'd die...
...What's that about？
I was thinking... maybe Rinko writes off a lot of stuff without trying it...
Some things are fun once you actually see them, right？
...Yeah. Admitting it kind of feels like losing, though.
(Losing to what...)
How was it？
Kobayakawa
It was way better made than I expected. I was surprised.
Kids these days have picky taste. It needs to be good, right？
This is the movie version, right？ Is it on TV too？
It's a remake. It was huge when people about ten years younger than my parents were kids...
Huh. So some of the kids here might've come with their dads？
Maybe. Anime crosses generations.
So the anime Rinko watched might get remade when we're grown-ups too？
Totally possible.
Then maybe I should study up on anime...？ I don't want my kids making fun of me...
(Thinking pretty far ahead...)
Ah, that was fun. What did you think, ▲小早川＊▲？
Kobayakawa
So-so. It was kind of, you know.
I see. I thought the science was pretty well researched and believable.
Not that. At heart it's a human drama, but the action felt tacked on and didn't tie into the main story.
...I-I see.
It almost got there, though.
...Should we go, then？
Oh, wait. I'm buying the program.
(...Wait, is she hooked？)
(More painful than scary... Does she remember digging her nails into my hand the whole time...)
Kobayakawa
What？ Is there something on Rinko's face？
Um... ▲小早川＊▲, you're not good with scary stuff？
Not really？ Why？
Well. Holding my hand is fine, but you were squeezing really hard.
No way...？ Rinko didn't hold your hand.
You were squeezing it hard enough to hurt...
That's... think of it as reliving the characters' pain with them...
I'll pass on that！
Kobayakawa
Ugh！ Pins left on both sides！
Looks like I win.
You don't know that yet. I just have to knock those down.
That's a tough one, though. There are a few ways to do it...
Um... I don't get it. Show me？
All right. Watch this.
Yes！
That's amazing！
How's that.
That gives Rinko a spare. Just a little more and I'll catch up！
Huh？ Did I just get played!?
Okay, your turn.
Let's see... Time bonus？ Get a strike in the next ten minutes and win a prize.
Kobayakawa
Huh, they have that？
What do we do？ Who throws？
Rinko passes. No way I'd get a strike.
So I'm doing it？
A guy who comes through when it counts is a real man, right？
Fine... Hyah！
Yes！ How's that！ That's a real man for you！
Wow, wow. Not bad at all！
Wonder what the prize is？
Oh, it says here. A free shoe rental ticket.
...That's a letdown.
Kobayakawa
Ugh, another gutter ball.
Don't worry about it.
The lane's totally warped！ No way it'd curve like that！
Sure... There's a trick to it.
A trick？
Okay... I'll try.
Oh, you're right.
See？
How was I supposed to know that if you didn't tell me！
(I teach her and she gets mad at me...)
Kobayakawa
See？ Music's gotta be like this.
Glad you liked it.
Ugh, my whole body's on fire！
Glad you liked it, but if you don't cool down, you'll collapse on the way home.
Way to kill the mood. You're seriously lacking in youth.
We're one year apart.
But you talk like an old man sometimes. Are you lying about your age？
Of course not.
Then could you handle all-night karaoke？
...High schoolers shouldn't pull all-nighters.
Ahaha. See, you sound just like my dad.
How was it？
Kobayakawa
I was a little... surprised. It actually got fun.
Yeah, it pulls you in.
The sax guy was so cool. You should try it. Rinko might melt at your playing, you know？
I can't.
You say that without even trying？
Then will you listen even if I'm bad？
No way. Come back to Rinko when you go pro.
(Long road ahead...)
Kobayakawa
...Sigh.
What's wrong, ▲小早川＊▲？
...This genre just doesn't click with Rinko.
Really？ Hip-hop's kind of Western music, isn't it？
Don't lump them together. What Rinko listens to is more, like...！
Forget it. People who don't get it won't get it.
I see. So you didn't really enjoy it.
...You don't need to worry about it. It's Rinko's own thing.
Then to cleanse our ears, let's talk about the music ▲小早川＊▲ likes.
Ugh, there you go acting all grown-up！ It makes Rinko look like a kid！
Haha, sorry, sorry.
That was lively. What did you think？
Kobayakawa
It was fun.
Glad to hear it.
Watching the person next to me.
Next to you... me？
Yep. Every time a song started you'd make a little noise, and you swayed to the beat... I wish I'd filmed it.
Let's not have fun in such unwholesome ways...
Next time I'll bring a video camera.
Cameras aren't allowed！
Okay, okay.
How was it？
Kobayakawa
The girls next to us were squealing the whole time. It was like an idol concert.
Comedians are popular with girls these days, I hear.
You're way funnier, though. Without even trying.
That's too much praise... Wait, was that praise？
It was. I'd get bored of comedians fast, but I never get bored watching you.
I can't tell funny stories like that.
That's fine. You're Rinko's exclusive. No need to entertain the masses.
Getting a kick out of her boyfriend is a girlfriend's privilege, right？
Kobayakawa
Hey, wasn't one of the actors someone from TV？
Yeah. Lately, a lot of TV actors come from places like this.
Huh, I see.
Even people who are new to TV sometimes have tons of fans from way back.
Hmm. I wonder if anyone today will make it big on TV.
Who knows. Nobody really stood out that much.
...Aren't you acting like an expert？ Fine. If the actor Rinko picked today makes it big, Rinko wins.
(It's not exactly a contest...)
Kobayakawa
Phew, I'm beat.
Nice job. That one just got added, right？
Yeah. They added a ton of Western songs lately. Now there are so many I can sing, it's a problem.
Anyway, Rinko's the only one singing. Put something in.
I'm fine just listening.
It's just us, no need to be shy. Oh, Rinko wants to hear this one. Try singing it？
Okay. Can you punch in the number？
Okay.
...Something like that.
You're good！ Why weren't you singing？
Because I'd rather listen to ▲小早川＊▲ sing.
That's such a waste. Okay, this one. Sing this too. Come on, encore！
(...This got out of hand.)
Sang my heart out... Okay, my score is...？
Kobayakawa
You know, listening to you, aren't you just scoring points by being loud？
If it gets points, no problem.
Just watching you is raising my blood pressure. Singing like that, you'll wreck your throat.
I see... If ▲小早川＊▲ is worried, I'll stop singing like that.
Yeah, good idea. Oh, right. Why not get a drink while you rest？ Rinko'll order one too.
Sure. Can you order something for me？
Okay. Then... Oh, wow. Super-spicy chili pepper drink. This one's yours.
Hey！
▲小早川＊▲, I was thinking of singing something like this next. How about it？
Kobayakawa
Is that a duet？
Yeah, since we're here.
A solo duet？ How sad. I'll pretend I don't know you.
I'm not singing it alone！
I know. We're singing it together, right？ Duets are super couple-y. Sounds good.
Then it's decided.
...Huh？
...Hey, isn't this the wrong song？
...I punched in the wrong number！ I'll fix it right away...
Bzzt, too late. I'm not in a duet mood anymore. I'm putting in punk. Fast and loud.
Kobayakawa
Huh... It stopped...？ No way...
...Wonder what happened. It'll start again soon.
...Yeah, I think so, but...
Hey... want to hold hands until it moves？
Oh, it's moving again.
Haha. It could have read the mood a little better.
...Thanks.
Wow. This thing goes up really high.
Kobayakawa
Weird. Only kids get excited about the view on a Ferris wheel.
Is that so？ What else would you do on a Ferris wheel？
I mean, a Ferris wheel's a closed room.
A closed room？ Well, I guess it is.
So, it's just the two of us.
Right.
Ugh！ We're a couple, so look at each other, not the view！
Sorry. Um... Were you expecting something？
Wha... Idiot！
Kobayakawa
Ugh... I feel sick...
Was it that scary？ You okay？
No, walking in the dark made me dizzy...
That's worse. Want to rest somewhere？
I'm fine. It'll pass.
Don't push it...
...Ugh, that was awful.
You don't look okay.
Hyah！
Ow！
See？ I'm fine.
'See,' she says...
Kobayakawa
They're selling something at the entrance. What is it？ A charm？
I heard this place is so scary they sell goods that make it go easy on you.
What's that？ If you need to buy that, just don't go in.
Maybe I'll buy one just in case... Can you hold onto it, ▲小早川＊▲？
We don't need that...
That was it going easy on us...？ That was intense...
Was it？ It was normal？
Wow, then next time want to go in without the charm？
Denied！
Kobayakawa
Phew, that was fun.
Yeah, this thrill is the best.
Another round？
Another round？ I could go all day.
Oh, big talk. Then it's a contest.
...Ugh, I'm wiped.
What's wrong？ Out of gas？
Don't compare me to a guy... Rinko's delicate, you know.
Um... is that a joke？
I'm gonna get mad！
Sorry, sorry.
By the way, you're good with this kind of thing, ▲小早川＊▲？
Kobayakawa
Of course.
So high...
Hey, are you scared？ You're making a weird face.
Sorry, I don't have a lot of room to spare right now.
Tch, how pathetic.
Hey, the scary part's over. You can make a normal face now.
And your hair's all messed up. Hilarious！
(She's merciless...)
Kobayakawa
Hey... do you think this has a hypnotic effect？
Where's that coming from？
It's just... staring at the lights makes my head go all fuzzy.
Are the lights making you dizzy？
Maybe. I don't know.
Want to move away and rest？
No, I don't feel sick. And I want to watch a bit more.
...Okay, fine. If it gets bad, you can hold onto my arm.
Okay... Thanks.
That one that just passed is the new float in this parade.
Kobayakawa
Huh？ Which one？
The giant doll in front of the carriage with ribbons. It was in a magazine.
Ugh, I can't even tell which one's the ribbon carriage.
It's already way off. Want to chase after it？
...No, it's crowded. I'll see it next time.
Apparently it's only this week, though.
...You want to show me that badly？
We came here together, so.
...Well, if you insist... I'll go, I guess...
All right. Let's go.
...Okay.
Kobayakawa
Ugh, it's so crowded！
Looks like the whole park gathered here.
Let's forget this and go somewhere else. Oh, we could ride the Ferris wheel and watch from above.
Easy for you to say. Just getting out of this crowd is a pain.
But we've gotta manage somehow, right？
Then... let's manage.
Got it. Time for my little kick.
No！ What's kicking people aside gonna do？
Kidding. You always take me seriously.
Urgh...
Fine, we'll stay. But if Rinko starts getting squashed, you protect me with everything you've got, got it？
▲小早川＊▲, how well can you actually swim？
Kobayakawa
...Why？
I've never really seen you swim seriously.
We came here to have fun. Why swim till I'm tired？
But knowing how far you can swim might come in handy in an emergency, right？
An emergency... like what？
...Like falling off a ship, or the city sinking into the sea.
That knowledge doesn't sound very useful...
...Yeah.
Instead of useless trivia like that, why not learn how to save someone who's drowning？
Like a lifeguard.
That's it. A guy who can do that is cool.
Phew... I swam a ton... Now I'm beat...
Kobayakawa
Huh. You're not bad.
I'm pretty fast, I guess. Maybe.
Want me to give you a nickname？
Let me guess. Kappa or something.
...There's nothing else for it. Or do you have a better idea？
No, but since you're at it, think of one？
Cucumber...
Get off the kappa theme.
This waterslide's famous enough to be in magazines. Longest or biggest or something.
Kobayakawa
Hmm, longest or biggest or something, huh...
Want to try it？
...I don't mind, but has it been proven safe？
Huh？
There've been a lot of accidents lately. I think consumers need to be skeptical about safety first.
...Um... You don't want to go？
I didn't say that.
Okay, then let's go！
Wait a sec...！ Look, the end of that thing is deep, and it's sudden, so water goes up your nose...！
Coming to places like this makes me think stargazing once in a while isn't bad.
Kobayakawa
The real thing would be better, though.
Then maybe we should go stargazing somewhere with clean air.
Will you narrate the stars then, like they do here？
I'll try to memorize some.
Then I'll look forward to it.
Oh, the next part's starting...
Asleep...
Mmm...
(Even if I memorize all this, it'll just be a lullaby for her.)
Kobayakawa
A long time ago, I begged my dad to buy me a home planetarium.
Huh, you liked stars？
Kind of. Everyone goes through a phase like that.
I was super excited about it, but...
The bumps in the room get in the way, right？
Yeah, that. It's never like a real planetarium.
So the planetarium is the best way to see them after all.
The best is the real thing, obviously.
Well, sure.
So remember today's talk, until we can go on dates late at night.
It's about to start... It's dark, I might get sleepy.
Kobayakawa
It's starting, so be quiet...
(Crap. I fell asleep...)
(...Huh？ ▲小早川＊▲ is asleep too？)
(She must be tired. I'll let her sleep a little longer.)
Hey, what were you doing, falling asleep？
Huh？ ▲小早川＊▲.
Morning. You awake？
Geez. You actually fell asleep. So embarrassing.
(Says the girl who fell asleep too...)
Kobayakawa
I don't hate flowers, but there are bugs here too, right？
Well, flowers and bugs kind of go together.
Well, sure, but...
Oh... um, look, isn't that flower cute？
That's a carnivorous plant.
Huh!?
No. I like it even more now！ Go get 'em, carnivorous plant！
(Such a sore loser...)
Kobayakawa
Stop, stop！
What's wrong, ▲小早川＊▲？
A bee！ There's a bee！
Huh, really？ Oh, there's one over there too.
Huh, no way！ No, no, no！
Let's back off so we don't provoke them.
I know, but... be careful too, okay？
I'm fine. If it comes to it, I'll pick up ▲小早川＊▲ and run.
Never mind that. Sacrifice yourself and let Rinko get away.
All right, leave it to me！
...Wait, so I'm the decoy？
Kobayakawa
Seeing these super long scientific names, don't you want to do tongue twisters？
Where's this coming from？
Just try reading these three plants' names in a row.
First, Aglaonema commutatum warburgii？ A houseplant in the arum family.
And... Erythrorhipsalis pilocarpa？ Huh, a cactus.
Last... Ascocentrum ampullaceum album. An orchid.
Come on. Say them, fast.
That's tough... I know, show me how first.
Rinko？
Come on, come on.
...Like anyone could say these.
(Then don't make me do it...)
Kobayakawa
...Phew.
Were you asleep？
No, I was listening. ...Halfway.
I see. Halfway, huh.
I just can't get into it unless the music's aggressive.
Aggressive, huh... I think classical has some... like contemporary music.
Hmm. But that's weird. Classical, but contemporary？
Modern pieces that come from the classical tradition, I guess.
Huh, then what do you call classical music written after that？ Future music？
...Good question.
Kobayakawa
Being an idol's tough, huh. Rinko could never do that.
I figured you'd tear it apart.
Whether I respect it and whether I like it are two different things.
I see.
There were some intense people in the crowd. Cheering in unison, dancing together...
Yeah, that was something.
Dealing with them must take a lot of energy.
Thinking about it, being an idol must be rough...
Even one's a handful. With that many, sure it's tough.
One？ Does ▲小早川＊▲ have a fan？
Yep. A really devoted one▼
Kobayakawa
The actors have crazy stamina, huh. Singing, dancing, and acting.
Yeah, I could never do that.
So try it. I'll watch, come on.
...If ▲小早川＊▲ does it with me.
Like I'd do that.
I can't do it either, not with this many people around.
Huh？ So you'd do it at home？ What a weirdo.
(How did it come to that...)
That was intense. Amazing nobody gets hurt doing that.
Kobayakawa
They do when they do. That's why they train. It's a real fight, after all.
So ▲小早川＊▲ is the type who insists pro wrestling is real？
Not exactly. Even if there's a script, they still go all out with it.
So pro wrestlers really are amazing.
Well, obviously.
All right, let's go get autographs.
Don't you have to be in the fan club for that？
We'll be fine. I heard they're pretty cool about it.
...You've got guts in the weirdest places.
Today's game was a slugfest...
Kobayakawa
So many hits. Amazing how they just keep smacking it out.
Do you have a favorite team, ▲小早川＊▲？ If you do, we'll see their game next time.
Rinko's favorite... is whichever one makes the stores hold a sale when they win.
Practical.
So what？ I don't play sports myself. That's about all the interest I have.
(It's like watching a game with a housewife...)
Kobayakawa
I didn't think you'd actually like it.
At first I was like, 'Whoa, why are there so many people？'
I had no idea there were fan clubs for such niche music.
Glad there was something you liked.
If it's stuff like this, I might come again.
...Well, don't get in too deep.
Not planning to. The crowds still wear me out.
Yeah, I'm pretty tired too.
I lost count of how many times I wanted to clear a path with a little kick.
(Scary...)
Kobayakawa
Hmm. So this is the famous night view.
What do you think？
Well, it's just okay. 'Stars on the ground'? They're just lights.
I see. I figured girls like this kind of thing.
There's no such person as 'girls.' Everyone's different. Rinko is Rinko.
That's tough...
Can you tell what tough Rinko is thinking right now？
...I'd like you to tell me.
That even an ordinary view isn't bad when I'm watching it with you.
Kobayakawa
Ah, hey. Don't look over there.
What's that all of a sudden？
The couple next to us is kissing！
Huh!?
I said don't look！
Geez, right out in the open with all these people... Young people's morals are seriously declining！
It seems like that kind of place... If anything, we're the ones who stand out for being so calm...
No, no！ If we stay here, Rinko and you will turn into an idiot couple too！ Let's go.
Kobayakawa
Huh. Even an iron bridge like that sways in the wind？
Bending with it is probably sturdier than not moving at all.
A lesson about not taking everything head-on.
What's that？ Are you talking about Rinko？
Just in general. Does it ring a bell？
No. You said it looking at me, so I just thought you meant Rinko.
Sorry.
Rinko thinks she's doing fine. Going with the flow with her older boyfriend while wrapping him around her finger.
(So that's what she's been thinking...)
Kobayakawa
People who come to the beach must be really confident in their figures, huh？
Plenty of people don't care, I bet.
No way！ Look at that bouncy chest. And a waist so thin you wonder where her organs go.
You're overthinking it.
Maybe, but it bugs me. Like whether your eyes'll wander to someone else...
Let me see...
Why are you looking at Rinko？
I don't think I need to look at anyone else.
...I get it, so quit staring at me！
Whew, what a swim.
Kobayakawa
I didn't think anyone came to the beach to swim that seriously.
Isn't the beach for swimming？
Is it？ I don't see a lot of people doing that.
Look around. It's all couples and families playing, and guys hitting on girls.
Maybe, but...
People who swim nonstop at the beach are a minority. They stick out.
I feel like I'm being blamed for something. Why？
Swimsuit kick！
Ow.
Think about the girlfriend you left alone while you swam！
It's this late already... We really played a lot...
Oh, look, ▲小早川＊▲. The sunset's beautiful.
Kobayakawa
I've seen plenty of sunsets.
Don't say that. A sunset seen from a place like this is special.
If the sunset were blue, it'd be worth seeing. Call me then.
You'd have to go to Mars for that.
...Huh？ Sunsets on Mars are blue？
Apparently. It was on TV the other day.
Then... I'll watch Mars'.
How about watching an Earth sunset first, for comparison？
Geez, fine...
Kobayakawa
Maybe I'll take my shoes off.
Hey, careful.
Hehe, this feels nice on my feet.
You already did.
Why don't you take yours off？
I'm good.
Old man！ If you don't take them off, I'll do it for you？
Okay, okay, I'll take them off.
Then let's go into the sea. Just our feet.
(She's actually excited for once. She looks happy...)
Kobayakawa
The sea in winter is nice and quiet, but there's not much to do. It's cold, and the water's freezing.
Yeah... Hm？ Something's there... A message in a bottle？
Huh, what？ Does it say anything？
Hold on... Um, "May this love last forever..."
...What's that？ Some other couple gushing？ Trash？
Trash is harsh.
But common sense says it's trash. It's Rinko and you who are stuck with it now.
Well, if we're not throwing it back in, it's the trash can.
Idiot couples are such a nuisance！
Kobayakawa
Whoa, look at the stars...
The stars feel closer in winter, huh.
Yeah. Winter actually has the prettiest night sky of the year.
Huh. That's Orion, right？ Even Rinko knows that one.
I feel like I could look at it forever.
Not in this cold, though.
That's when Rinko's personal hand warmer comes in, right？
...Yeah, yeah. At your service.
Hehe...
Kobayakawa
I read somewhere that more guys than girls think the fish at aquariums look tasty.
I see.
But I don't think anyone looks at this one and thinks "yum."
Apparently you can eat that one.
Huh？ Really？
Whether you'd want to is another story.
